05/16.09.2023  Heard the parties.

The petitioner has been made an accused in connection with Panki P.S. Case No. 16 of 2022 for the offences under Sections 341, 342, 323, 324, 504, 506, 379, 498A of the Indian Penal Code, Sections 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act and Sections 3 and 4 of Prevention of Witch (Daain) Practices Act,
pending in the court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Palamau at Daltonganj.
Anticipatory Bail Application of the petitioner was earlier rejected vide A.B.A. No.5685 of 2022 subsequently the petitioner has surrendered before the learned court below and taken into custody.
Petitioner is the husband of the opposite party No.2.

entities.text: Chief Judicial Magistrate, Palamau at Daltonganj
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is alleged that the petitioner had demanded Rs.2,00,000/- from the opposite party No.2 by way of dowry, to enforce the demand she was tortured and ultimately, she was driven away from her matrimonial home.
It further appears that the opposite party No.2 had given birth to a second child.
The petitioner alleged that he had not sired the child.

Mr. Rajnikant Ojha, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the opposite party No.2 has vehemently opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that the petitioner is not maintaining opposite party No.2 and her children.

It was further submitted that the opposite party No.2 wants to resume her Akash Kumar Singh @ Lakhendra Singh vs The State Of Jharkhand on 16 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/15304084/
1 matrimonial relationship, but the petitioner was adamant not to receive her back.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: On specific query by this Court whether the opposite party No.2 has sustained any injury at the hands of the petitioner.
It was submitted that the opposite party No.2 has not sustained any serious injury.
Considering the period of custody and the fact that the opposite party No.2 has not sustained any serious injury at the hands of the petitioner.

He is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs. 20,000/- (Rupees twenty thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Palamau at Daltonganj in connection with Panki P.S. Case No. 16 of 2022.
